typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	gv_OraclePassword as string (),
	gv_OracleProvider as string (),
	gv_OracleUserID as string (),
	gv_SqlServerProvider as string (),
	gv_strOracleDS as string (),
	strDataSource as string (),
	strInitialCatalog as string (),
	strPassword as string (),
	strUserName as string ()
}

source(output(
		BGBG_ID as string,
		BLIV_ID as string,
		DUE as string,
		BLIV_CREATE_DTM as string,
		GRGR_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> InputPlaceHolderOracleSource
InputPlaceHolderOracleSource derive({Copy of DUE} = DUE,
		{Copy of BLIV_CREATE_DTM} = BLIV_CREATE_DTM) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{Copy of DUE} as string,
		{Copy of BLIV_CREATE_DTM} as string,
		DUE as string,
		BLIV_CREATE_DTM as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	mapColumn(
		{Copy of DUE},
		{Copy of BLIV_CREATE_DTM},
		DUE,
		BLIV_CREATE_DTM)) ~> OutputPlaceHolderOracleDestination
